title: Probabilistic Risk Sensitivity and Loss Aversion in Cumulative Prospect Theory
abstract: arXiv:2606.06652v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops a binary-gamble framework for characterizing risk sensitivity and loss aversion in Cumulative Prospect Theory (CPT). The proposed probabilistic risk-sensitivity metric is defined as a probability-threshold ratio that determines acceptance and preference thresholds in choice problems involving either a certain outcome and a binary gamble or two binary gambles. We show how standard notions of symmetric and non-symmetric bet aversion can be recovered within this framework, and we compare the resulting threshold-based conditions with utility premia, probability premia, and Arrow-Pratt curvature measures. The analysis clarifies when these criteria coincide and when they diverge, particularly for increasing aversion conditions, binary gambles with unequal probability distributions, and settings involving probability weighting functions. translated_title: 累积前景理论中的概率风险敏感性与损失厌恶
translated_abstract: 本文建立了一个二元赌博框架，用于刻画累积前景理论中的风险敏感性与损失厌恶。所提出的概率风险敏感性度量被定义为一个概率阈值比率，该比率在涉及某一确定结果与二元赌博、或两个二元赌博之间的选择问题中，决定了接受阈值与偏好阈值。我们展示了如何在该框架内恢复对称与非对称赌注厌恶的标准概念，并将由此得到的基于阈值的条件与效用溢价、概率溢价以及Arrow-Pratt曲率度量进行比较。该分析阐明了这些标准何时一致、何时出现分歧，特别是在厌恶程度递增条件、概率分布不相等的二元赌博、以及涉及概率加权函数的设定中。我们还识别了在使用CPT效用函数时所出现的技术性限制。
tldr: 本文提出以概率阈值比率定义的二元赌博框架来刻画累积前景理论中的风险敏感性与损失厌恶，并将其阈值条件与效用溢价、概率溢价及Arrow-Pratt曲率度量进行比较，阐明了各标准何时一致、何时分歧。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a binary-gamble framework with a probabilistic risk-sensitivity metric defined as a probability-threshold ratio to characterize risk sensitivity and loss aversion in Cumulative Prospect Theory, comparing threshold-based conditions with utility premia, probability premia, and Arrow-Pratt curvature measures to clarify when these criteria coincide or diverge.
